statements.status_notes: nsenter --join-cgroup opened the target cgroup.procs file as root and left the descriptor open across the later namespace and credential changes, so a program run in an attacker-controlled target could inherit root's authority to move host processes between cgroups. Upstream's complete fix closes the descriptor straight after the join (commit https://github.com/util-linux/util-linux/commit/afe067c979b9ba2cbe856f7c6411210120ea62aa); see https://github.com/util-linux/util-linux/security/advisories/GHSA-55fx-f4gg-cfhj and https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-78408. The util-linux 2.41.6 release only opens cgroup.procs close-on-exec (commit https://github.com/util-linux/util-linux/commit/43ec8a89f6c99130727084b3496a2ffd2b4200f0) and keeps the descriptor open until exec. Alpine backports the complete fix in 2.41.6-r1 and lists the CVE as fixed there (https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/commit/96f05433b217acf92bee031df551b10d8b3a1ec2); this range follows that. Compared nsenter in the util-linux-misc package of every published DHI Alpine 3.23 build (2.41.2-r0, 2.41.4-r0, 2.41.6-r0, 2.41.6-r1) on x86_64 and aarch64: 2.41.6-r1 makes two more close() calls than every earlier build, matching the two the fix adds. The range ends at 2.41.6-r1.

nsenter --join-cgroup opened the target cgroup.procs file as root and left the descriptor open across the later namespace and credential changes, so a program run in an attacker-controlled target could inherit root's authority to move host processes between cgroups. Upstream's complete fix closes the descriptor straight after the join (commit https://github.com/util-linux/util-linux/commit/afe067c979b9ba2cbe856f7c6411210120ea62aa); see https://github.com/util-linux/util-linux/security/advisories/GHSA-55fx-f4gg-cfhj and https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-78408. The util-linux 2.42.3 release does not change how cgroup.procs is opened (its close-on-exec commit https://github.com/util-linux/util-linux/commit/3d9e4d5ec49662570b32046e61a7c8deacfafd34 covers other descriptors). Alpine backports the complete fix in 2.42.3-r1 and lists the CVE as fixed there (https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/commit/d98c55af59055e6ca60fbe36e171546918709965). Compared nsenter in the util-linux-misc package of every published DHI Alpine 3.24 build (2.42-r0, 2.42.1-r0, 2.42.3-r0 for aarch64 only, 2.42.3-r1) on x86_64 and aarch64: 2.42.3-r1 makes two more close() calls than every earlier build, matching the two the fix adds, and on x86_64 it opens cgroup.procs with O_CLOEXEC where 2.42-r0 and 2.42.1-r0 do not. The range ends at 2.42.3-r1.
